item.title: On a Box Without an NVIDIA Card, I Tore NVIDIA's Closed Network Apart Down to the Bone
item.description: NVIDIA's DLSS 5 neural rendering network was reimplemented in pure Vulkan, byte-exact at all 75 block boundaries. My machine has no NVIDIA card, so I can't verify the signature GPU-side bit-exact parity. But I shallow-cloned the repo, read the source, cross-checked the 71-block graph, and actually ran one PTX divider regression on my own box — I tore it apart as far as I could tear it, said what I can say, and wrote down flat what I can't.
